description: This file defines the EntityId interface, representing an immutable identifier for entities, with default methods for string operations and comparison, plus an abstract method to check if the ID is a dummy.

classes.name: EntityId
classes.description: An immutable interface for entity identifiers, extending CharSequence and Comparable, providing default string and comparison behaviors, and a method to determine if the ID is a dummy.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the ID's string representation.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index in the ID's string representation.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence string of the ID's string representation from start to end indices.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this ID to another EntityId based on their string representations.

methods.name: isDummy
methods.description: Abstract method to determine whether this ID is a dummy ID.
